prompt:
Use case: illustration-story
Edit image 1, the existing black-and-white riverfront line drawing. Images 2 and 3 are the original real-place references, supplied only to keep the riverbank construction and building/mountain relationships credible. Do not restart or create a different town.
Return one landscape 16:9 line drawing, target 1920x1080, plain white background.

Make only these two coordinated revisions:
1. Simplify this drawing very substantially into an early structural layout sketch. Remove about 80 percent of interior texture/detail marks. Keep the existing outer building silhouettes, the main roof planes, essential posts, floor lines, door/window openings. Use only occasional tile or masonry joints, not full repeated rows. Replace densely stippled forests with lightly drawn hill contours and 3-5 broad foliage mass outlines; leave hill interiors mostly white. Remove almost all water reflections, retaining the shoreline and a few widely spaced horizontal ripples. Reduce foreground paving to a handful of incomplete perspective joints, with large plain white areas between. Leaves on the foreground framing tree become a few broad canopy outlines, no individual leaves. Keep near structures somewhat stronger and far contours lighter. No gray shading, wash or hatching.
2. Move the entire near-bank stair assembly a modest distance FARTHER ALONG the same street, toward the vanishing point, so the whole connected top opening, steps, side walls, bottom landing and its waterline are clearly within the middle band of the image. Its lower landing and water-facing edge should finish above y=72% of image height; the bottom 24% must contain only simple continuous pavement/bank/water, not the important stair-to-landing junction. Reduce the assembly's apparent scale naturally with its increased distance. Redraw the nearby retaining wall continuously where it used to sit. Do not move just the lower landing or sever steps from street/water. Show one stair assembly only. Preserve a usable street behind it, normal step proportions, solid sidewall, and the lower landing resting just above water.

Preserve the camera, horizon, left houses/right river composition, overall bank curve, modest street width, irregular building volumes, original roof heights, distant hill positions, and physically connected house thresholds -> street -> stair top -> steps -> low landing -> water. No large plaza. No people, boats, magic, signage/text, modern equipment, bridges, pagodas, added buildings or decorative props. The result should be a clear editable working sketch, not a detailed coloring-book illustration.
